frame.description: The overall context every part's agent gets: what the whole task is about, what counts as a good finding, what to avoid. Sources named here are starting points, not limits: the agents search the web themselves.

parts.description: The task split into independent groups, one sub-agent each, run one after the other. A part is what one agent can do in one go and report on with a status for every position. Do not split a small task.

id.description: Short unique id of the part

title.description: Title of the part, shown in the progress and the result

task.description: What the agent of this part does, complete and self-contained: it sees neither the conversation nor the other parts

positions.description: The single things of this part, each of which gets an entry with a status (found, not found, error). At least one.

id.description: Short unique id of the position inside the part ('zusatz' is reserved)

name.description: Name of the position as the agent should look for it

columns.description: Optional values every entry carries besides status, finding and source. Only for values that are compared (prices, counts); not for text that belongs in the finding.

name.description: Name of the column (not position_id, status, befund, quelle, neue_quellen)

type.description: Type of the values: text, zahl (number) or link

trend.description: Optional: the course of one number over the runs of a recurring job (a table in the closing report). Needs a column of type zahl.

value.description: Name of the zahl column whose course is shown
